name: Shirayuki Miho
source: A sweet, but slightly airheaded girl who believes in fairies and hopes to meet her Prince Charming. Fortune-telling is her big hobby, and she holds a reputation in the school of always giving out correct predictions. Best friends with Miyuki Kotobuki.
